prompt:
Aspect ratio 16:9, landscape. Desktop WEBSITE DESIGN MOCKUP, a screen design, not a photograph.
GROUND: dark warm-black photo-album card page #14120F, fibrous heavy black album stock. Never cream, parchment or sepia.
DOMINANT (~62% width, centred slightly left, middle band): one wide panoramic photograph of a narrow Atlantic peninsula city — sea both sides, long sandy beach curving away, pale ochre apartment blocks, palm trees, deep blue Atlantic. Held by four small white paper photo corners, rotated ~1.5 degrees. One strip of pale ochre washi tape #C98A3E across its top edge.
OVERLAP upper right: perforated postage stamp, scalloped die-cut edge visible against the black ground, tilted ~6 degrees, containing a small photo of a white street sign reading "Cadiz", with a circular postmark ring in muted vermillion #C6362C reading "CADIZ · 03.09.2026".
RIGHT COLUMN (~16% width, full height): fourteen small horizontal index tabs stacked vertically, torn-edge strips of off-white paper #F2F0EB with handwritten dates in graphite. Four carry a small deep-blue #0F3B57 notch on the left edge. One tab is visibly, deliberately empty.
UPPER LEFT: title "Cadiz 2026" handwritten in silver pencil on the black card, smaller line beneath reading "zwei Wochen am Atlantik".
LOWER LEFT: three short lines of small body text in clean sans-serif, warm off-white, left-aligned.
COMMITMENT: one dominant move — the panoramic photograph in white corners on black album card. Everything else holds still.
PALETTE: #14120F, #0F3B57, #C98A3E, #C6362C, #F2F0EB.
AVOID: serif display typography, centred hero text over full-bleed photo, rounded-corner card grids, gradient overlays, glassmorphism, neon, drop shadows beyond what a photo corner casts.
structural_question: Panorama in Fotoecken; Zeit fuehrt ueber den Reiterstapel rechts. Entscheidungs-Comp der gewaehlten Richtung, unveraendert uebernommen.
